character: High, snow-sure duty-free town in Lombardy's Alta Valtellina near the Swiss border, with two main ski areas on opposite sides of the valley: Carosello 3000 and Mottolino (known for its snow park). Livigno hosted snowboard and freestyle events at the 2026 Winter Olympics (reference).
learning: 29 of 78 runs are blue (search summary); ski schools in the village (reference). Confirm beginner areas.
